sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, o.created_at::text AS t, o.market_ticker AS b, coalesce(o.side,'-') AS c, coalesce(o.action,'-') AS d, o.limit_price::text AS e, o.quantity::text AS f, coalesce(o.status,'-') AS h, coalesce(o.event_ticker,'-') AS i FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 14) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, p.captured_at::text, p.market_ticker, coalesce(p.side,'-'), 'pos', p.quantity::text, coalesce(p.avg_price::text,'-'), coalesce(p.realized_pnl::text,'-'), coalesce(p.market_exposure::text,'-') FROM positions p WHERE p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXTRUMPAPPROVE-26SEP18%' OR p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXRT-RES%' ORDER BY p.captured_at DESC LIMIT 10)) u ORDER BY g, t DESC
